about: [O1b] The el's train (brief §2, O1 Left 5): it runs the loop for ever, brakes into a station, stands there with its windows lit (the doors' time), pulls out; never gone at the station it left. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1b_train.json

steps.eval: (() => { const T = G.stage.train, st = G.stage.part('el').stops[T.stopAt]; const F = {}; G.stage.part('el').line.at(T.s - T.dir * 4 * 14.5 / 2, F); return { station: st.name, d: +Math.hypot(F.x - st.x, F.z - st.z).toFixed(1), v: T.v, visible: T.group.visible }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const T = G.stage.train, st = G.stage.part('el').stops[T.stopAt]; const F = {}; G.stage.part('el').line.at(T.s - T.dir * 4 * 14.5 / 2, F); return Math.hypot(F.x - st.x, F.z - st.z) < 6 && T.v === 0 && T.group.visible; })()
